description: Create a new saved lesgooo plan with shareable links. Optionally adds the first participant and returns their private participant_token. Does not send invitations or notifications.

request_id.description: Optional UUID v4 for an atomic create with your_name. Keep the same UUID and fields on retry; never reuse it for a different plan.

title.description: Short plan name, e.g. "Weekend at the cabin" (max 120 chars).

your_name.description: Name of the person you act for; adds them as the first participant (max 80 chars).

name: create_plan
title: Create a plan
